what: Background sound button — if not yet turned on, four bars gently bob from 3→10px over 1.6s (an invitation), and after 2.6s a Sound on speech bubble pops out 12px below the button with .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.4) and floats 3px every 2.4s. When turned on, the bars jump 4→15px out of sync over .9s and the text changes to on. It turns on at the first press anywhere on screen (browser sound permission), and once turned off with the button it does not turn on again. If src exists, the sound ramps up to vol over 1.4s, and on turning off it fades down and stops over .5s

options.on · off: On/off text, default Sound on · Sound off
options.src: URL of the sound file to loop (shape only if empty)
options.nudge: Time to show the speech bubble (sec), default 2.6 — 0 means it is not shown
options.first: 1 turns on at the first press anywhere on screen (default), 0 only via the button

from.where: index.html header line .nn-sound — original music(): on by default, plays on first press, raises VOL .45 over 1400ms and lowers it over 500ms, nudge after 2600ms, bar eq .9s · tease 1.6s, speech bubble .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.4)

note: The original’s fallback to Web Audio when streaming doesn’t move within 2.2 seconds is left out, using a single HTMLAudio. fx:on and fx:off are fired from the button
